scope: Local bounded worker lifecycle event stream

criteria.description: The correction is local-only, reversible and bounded: a 256-entry redacted event buffer, opaque job/worker references, no tenant/workspace/collection/source/payload fields, and sink failures isolated from queue behavior
criteria.limitations: No exporter, collector, distributed aggregation, alert delivery, production deployment or external service effect is authorized

criteria.description: Failure-first package and worker tests can exercise capacity, immutability, redaction, lifecycle coverage and callback-failure isolation before a fresh independent review
criteria.limitations: The actual regression and fresh I1 review remain required after implementation

authority.scope: Local bounded worker lifecycle event stream
